notes: Both אִם particles take the written or under rule 14; the waw before the second of them is left unrepresented for want of a connective of its own.
The to of to him that sent me is placed on the participle's unit under rule 33, since שֹׁלְחִי is the bare indirect object while דָּבָר is the verb's object; rule 44 would put it on אָשִׁיב instead.
The thee of advise thee realizes the imperative's own person and number and stays with the verb (rule 44).
